estimand_note: the mean of fold-specific worst-group contrasts; the max over groups and the welfare ratio are nonlinear, so this is a different estimand from a maximum or ratio taken after pooling all out-of-fold respondents
method_note: the conventional corrected repeated-CV approximation, not an exact independence or coverage theorem; the correction widens the interval relative to treating the overlapping fold scores as independent, and coverage has not been established for this worst-group ratio statistic
naive_interval_label: diagnostic only, not for reporting: treats the overlapping split scores as independent and therefore understates the uncertainty
